messages.content: i need to go to the library just to return a book. i do not have time to stay.
you can return the book and leave. you do not need to stay and read.
my friend asked if i want to look for another book there.
you could say you only have time to return this book today.
write that for me.
i only have time to return this book today. maybe we can look for another one later.
hi pico. it is nice to be here.
hi. it is nice to talk with you.
can you say hello to my sister too?
hello to your sister too.
how many cups should i put on the table for dinner?
how many people will be there?
my mother, my father, my sister, and me.
put four cups on the table, one for each person.
my sister is not coming now.
then you need three cups for your mother, your father, and you.
write a question i can ask my teacher.
what do you want to ask about?
i do not understand the last page we read.
could you please help me understand the last page we read?
i just want help with the last sentence on that page.
could you please help me understand the last sentence on that page?
i want to read. the kitchen is busy and the bedroom is quiet.
the bedroom could be a quiet place to read.
but there is not much light in there. the living room has light and no one is there.
you could read in the living room. it has light, and you said no one is there.
which place did you choose after i said that?
the living room.
i do not want to go for a walk because i am tired. help me tell my friend.
i am tired, so i do not want to go for a walk right now.
i still want to see her. can you add that?
i am tired, so i do not want to go for a walk right now. i would still like to see you.
could we have tea at home instead?
you could ask: would you like to have tea at home instead?
i cleaned my kitchen this morning.
does it feel nice to have that done?
yes. i can see the table again.
now you have space to use the table.
i think i will sit there with a book.
that could be a quiet way to enjoy the clean space.
write a note from me to my brother. i found his hat.
i found your hat.
add that it is under my bed.
i found your hat under my bed.
is the bed his or my bed?
it is your bed. you are the person saying my in the note.
i often forget where i put my keys.
you could choose one place to keep them each time you come home.
i always put my bag on the chair by the door.
you could keep your keys in your bag, so they are with the thing you already put there.
i do not always take that bag when i leave.
then a little bowl by the door could work. you can check it before you leave.
i want to sit at a table where someone is already sitting. what can i ask?
is it okay if i sit here?
what if they say the place is for their friend?
you can thank them and look for another place.
write a short answer for that.
okay, thank you. i will find another place.
will there be rain tomorrow?
i do not know the weather for tomorrow where you are.
i just want a plan for if there is rain.
you could plan to stay inside or take a coat if you need to go out.
i want to visit my grandmother. she is near my house.
if there is rain, you could take a coat for the short walk to her house.
the color i like most is blue. what color did i say?
blue.
do you need to ask me again?
no. you already said blue.
my cup is not on the table. did someone take it?
maybe, but you do not know that just because it is not on the table.
i put it in the kitchen after breakfast. i remember that now.
then you can look in the kitchen.
did you know that before i said it?
no. i learned it from what you just said.
i drew a picture of a garden my grandmother has. help me give it a name.
you could call it: a quiet garden.
there are many people from my family in it. it is not quiet.
you could call it: family in the garden.
i want the name to be about the family.
family in the garden.
i had three pens. now i have seven. how many more do i have?
you have four more pens.
why did you not say seven?
seven is how many you have now. four is how many more you have than before.
now just tell me the number i have today.
seven.
my cousin still has my book. i want it back, but i want to ask in a kind way.
could you please bring my book back when you can?
i need it tomorrow for school.
could you please bring my book back tomorrow? i need it for school.
can i say thanks at the end?
could you please bring my book back tomorrow? i need it for school. thanks.
can we talk about my trip?
yes. where did you go?
i do not want to talk about it after all. ask me about music.
what music do you enjoy listening to?
quiet music while i read.
do you like a song with words, or just music while you read?
i asked my friend to visit tomorrow. should i make lunch for two?
has your friend said yes?
no. i just asked and i have no answer.
you could wait for the answer before making lunch for two.
what if i want to get ready before i have an answer?
you can get ready for the visit, but remember that your friend has not said yes.
help me choose my clothes for today.
where are you going, and what is the weather like?
i am going for a walk. it is cold and there is wind.
a warm coat could help for that walk.
i have a blue coat and a green coat. both are warm.
if both are warm, choose the color you would like to put on today.
picoboi, are you sitting next to me?
no. i am a model running in your browser.
why can i talk to you then?
you type words here, and the model makes an answer.
can you hear me if i do not type?
not here. i can use the words you type in this webpage.
i am writing a story. a boy cannot find his toy at the park. what could he do next?
he could look near the place where he last played with it.
can his sister help him?
yes. in the story, his sister could help him look.
write one sentence where she finds it.
his sister found the toy under a tree.
i have been studying and my mind feels tired.
you could take a short break before studying again.
i do not want to stop for all of the afternoon.
you can take a short break and then return to your work.
what could i do in the break?
you could stand up, drink some water, and walk around a little.
one apple is two coins. i want two apples. is two coins enough?
no. two apples at two coins each cost four coins.
i have five coins.
you can buy the two apples and have one coin left.
what if i only buy one apple?
you would spend two coins and have three coins left.
write a note saying i will bring the bag back tomorrow.
i will bring the bag back tomorrow.
add in the morning, but do not add why i have it.
i will bring the bag back tomorrow morning.
did you add a reason?
no. the note only says when you will bring the bag back.
what does the letter on my table say?
i cannot see the letter on your table. you can type its words here.
it says my uncle is coming in the evening.
then the letter says your uncle will come in the evening.
does it say which evening?
not in the words you gave me. is there more about the day?
is a big box always hard to carry?
no. a big box can be light, and a small box can be hard to carry.
my big box has only a little paper inside.
it may be easy to carry if it is light enough for you.
what do i need to check instead of just its size?
check how easy it is for you to hold and carry it.
i went to the market with my aunt.
what did you and your aunt do there?
sorry, i mean my uncle, not my aunt.
okay. what did you and your uncle do at the market?
we bought fruit.
what fruit did you buy?
my sister gave her book to my brother. who gave the book?
your sister gave the book.
who got it?
your brother got it.
but brother is the last person i said.
yes, but your sentence says your sister gave the book and your brother got it.
give me an idea for a little drawing.
a small boat under a big moon.
can you draw it on my paper?
no. i can give you an idea here, but i cannot draw on your paper.
what should i draw first?
you could draw the boat first, then add the moon above it.
i asked where my book is. my brother said it is in the house. is that wrong?
it may be true, but it does not say which room or place in the house.
i found it on the desk in my bedroom.
then it was in the house, and you now know which room and place too.
what could i ask next time for more help?
you could ask: where in the house is it?
i am making tea. can we talk while i make it?
yes. what kind of day are you having?
it has been a good day. i saw a friend for the first time in a year.
was it nice to see your friend again?
yes. we talked for a long time.
what did you enjoy talking about?
i had soup yesterday, but i want rice today. is that okay?
yes. you can have one thing yesterday and want another thing today.
do i have to keep choosing soup?
no. you can choose rice today.
what do i want now?
rice.
can you help me not forget my coat tomorrow?
i can help you write a note here, but i cannot call you tomorrow to say you need your coat.
what should i write on the note?
bring my coat tomorrow.
where could i put it?
you could put it by the door where you will see it before you leave.
i need to leave for school in a little while. i want to read and find my shoes.
find your shoes first so you are ready to leave.
i already found them. they are by the door.
then you can get them on and check how much time you have for reading.
i have no time for reading now.
you can leave for school and save the reading for later.
what is the opposite of up?
down.
and the opposite of open?
closed.
i put the pen my sister gave me to hold in my bag so i can carry it to her. is it my pen?
no. she gave it to you to hold, not to keep. your bag is just where you put it.
i am going to give it back tomorrow.
you can carry it in your bag and return it to her tomorrow.
who should i give it to?
your sister.
i want to ask my friend to have lunch with me, but she may be busy.
would you like to have lunch with me if you are free?
can you say it is okay if she cannot come?
would you like to have lunch with me if you are free? it is okay if you cannot come.
keep that last sentence but make the question shorter.
can you join me for lunch? it is okay if you cannot come.
i have two cups on the table. i moved one to the shelf. how many cups do i have?
you still have two cups. one is on the table and one is on the shelf.
did moving one make another cup?
no. it only changed where that cup is.
how many are on the table now?
one.
picoboi, i am thinking of a color. what is it?
i do not know the color you are thinking of.
can you try one color?
i can try blue, but i do not know if that is right.
it was yellow.
your color was yellow. blue was not right.
help me understand before. give me an example first.
i wash my hands before i eat.
what does before tell me there?
you wash your hands first, and then you eat.
can you use after to say the same order?
i eat after i wash my hands.
i plan to study at the library, but it is closed.
is there another quiet place where you can study?
my room is quiet today.
you could study in your room instead.
i still want to do the same work.
you can keep the same work and just change the place where you study.
write to my cousin that i will be there in the morning.
i will be there in the morning.
do not say i will take the bus. i do not know how i will go.
i will be there in the morning.
what do you know about how i will get there?
you have not said how you will get there.
i plan to put a flower on the table. is the flower there now?
not from what you said. you said you plan to put it there.
i just did it.
now the flower is on the table.
what changed in what you know?
first you said you plan to do it. then you said you did it.
is this sentence right: she go to school?
you can write: she goes to school.
what if i mean yesterday?
she went to school yesterday.
keep it about yesterday but change school to the park.
she went to the park yesterday.
i am worried my friend did not like my letter.
did your friend say that, or are you worried because you have not had an answer?
i have not had an answer.
not having an answer does not tell you for sure how your friend felt about the letter.
i just want to wait for now.
okay. you can wait and see if your friend answers.
can you tell me what is in my photo?
i cannot see your photo here. you can tell me what is in it, and i can help you write about it.
it has my brother on a bike by a tree.
you could write: my brother is on a bike by a tree.
can you tell what color his shirt is?
no. you have not said the color of his shirt.
write a very short story about a lost key with a happy end.
a girl lost her key. her brother found it in her coat. she said thank you and went home.
please stop the story there.
okay. that is the end.
i can walk or ride my bike to the park. i think i will walk.
a walk could be nice. do you want help with the way there?
no, i know the way. i just want to choose.
okay. you chose to walk.
yes. thanks.
you are welcome.
write a sentence with right.
you are going the right way.
now write one with write.
i write a letter.
are right and write the same word?
no. right and write can sound the same, but they are not the same word.
give me a sentence about a blue boat.
a blue boat is on the water.
add the moon, but keep the boat blue.
a blue boat is on the water under the moon.
now make the boat small too.
a small blue boat is on the water under the moon.
